project.name: Chronobreak
project.description: Canonical Chronobreak work state. Draft items are refined; ready features are executed.

features.name: Build Canonical Chronobreak Feature Inventory
features.description: Audit the existing Chronobreak repository against product intent, discover actual implementation/architecture/verification, and replace the setup state with a truthful canonical feature list before implementing new product work.
acceptance_criteria: Existing user-visible Chronobreak behavior is mapped to canonical epics/features without assuming uninspected functionality is absent.
Broad product objectives are represented as epics and are not treated as directly executable features.
Concrete features are marked draft or ready based on the definition-readiness gate.
Already complete behavior is marked done only when supported by repository evidence and runnable verification.
Actual build/test/lint/type-check/media/benchmark entry points are documented in docs/development/VERIFICATION.md.
Durable architecture facts needed by future agents are documented under docs/architecture/.
The product-intent seed is fully reconciled into canonical state and then removed or archived as non-canonical.
No new product functionality is implemented as part of this audit.

verification.description: Review the resulting feature-list.json for full coverage of existing behavior and product-intent seed items.
Verify documented repository commands were discovered from actual project configuration rather than guessed.

features.notes: One-time setup item. Remove it from the canonical list after its acceptance criteria are satisfied.
